title: Gangsta's Paradise
source: purchased by Nomade (lossless file); no audio is published here, only analysis
tempo_note: automatic estimate, may be doubled or halved
spectrogram_text: Built on the chord loop of Stevie Wonder's "Pastime Paradise" (1976). In the rapped verses (0:00–0:47, 1:13–1:44, 2:24–2:47) the voice is alone in the stereo centre; in each sung chorus the choir and strings spread wide to the sides. A high held voice closes the song.
